description: This file defines the AccountingException class, a custom exception used within the org.apache.ofbiz.accounting module to handle critical errors related to accounting processes such as invoices, general ledger, and payments.

classes.name: AccountingException
classes.description: Custom exception class for serious accounting-related errors, extending GenericServiceException.

methods.name: AccountingException()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an exception with no detailed message or cause.

methods.name: AccountingException(Throwable throwable)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps another Throwable as the cause of this exception.

methods.name: AccountingException(String string)
methods.description: Constructor that creates this exception with a specific error message.

methods.name: AccountingException(String string, Throwable throwable)
methods.description: Constructor that creates this exception with a specific message and underlying cause.
